name: Pan Electronics (India) Limited
about: Pan Electronics (India) Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of BOPP films and capacitors. The company provides fans, motor run, motor start, air conditioning, washing machine, lighting, submersible pump, box type power factor correction (PFC), and cylindrical PFC capacitors, as well as metallized polypropylene polyester films. Pan Electronics (India) Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
